title: Affordable housing site and draft strategy
subtitle: Also: 8 Mitchell Street rezoning public meeting, Lyon pool grant, and heritage register removal.
overview: Council voted to declare 14 Edinburgh Road South surplus and directed staff to seek proposals for at least 12 affordable housing units there. Council added conditions: the units must stay affordable for 99 years, the City gets right of first refusal if the property is sold, and at least three units must be accessible to wheelchair users {{vote:m9}}. The site is the future former home of the Guelph Pottery Studio and is tied to a federal housing funding commitment.

Council also received the draft Housing Affordability Strategy {{vote:m10}}. A final version is expected on December 10 after more public engagement. Delegates urged action on renovation-related evictions, deeply affordable housing and student housing.

At the public meeting for 8 Mitchell Street, council received a proposal to rezone the former church site for two semi-detached buildings with up to twelve units in total {{vote:m3}}. No decision was made. Nearby residents raised concerns about parking, traffic, trees and neighbourhood fit. Council also endorsed two provincial grant applications, including one for Lyon pool repairs {{vote:m2}}, and removed two Edinburgh Road South properties from the heritage register {{vote:m1}}.

decisions.detail: Council declared the site surplus and directed staff to issue a request for proposals for at least 12 affordable units, with 99-year affordability, City right of first refusal and at least three wheelchair-accessible units {{vote:m9}}.

decisions.item: 99-year affordability and right of first refusal
decisions.detail: An amendment added a 99-year affordability requirement and a City right of first refusal if the property is put up for sale {{vote:m5}}.
Council changed the proposed three accessible units to a minimum of three units accessible to wheelchair users {{vote:m7}}.
Council received the draft strategy report so staff can continue engagement before bringing a final version back {{vote:m10}}.
Council received the application to rezone the site to allow semi-detached dwellings, with a decision to come at a later meeting {{vote:m3}}.
Council endorsed grant applications for Lyon Outdoor Pool rehabilitation and South End Community Centre enhancements {{vote:m2}}.
Council removed 302 and 306 Edinburgh Road South from the heritage register once the stone markers are installed at their original location {{vote:m1}}.

debate: On 8 Mitchell Street, nearby residents said the plan is effectively high density for a narrow historic street. They said parking is already tight, with some homes lacking driveways, and that more residents would add to street parking and to difficult turns onto Eramosa Road.

Neighbours also raised loss of mature trees, more runoff and flooding on the street, and the size of the buildings. A neighbouring resident said construction would likely kill large trees on their property and asked for a tree protection responsibility for adjacent owners.

The applicant's planner said the proposal fits the low density designation and the city's zoning framework, and that most special provisions simply mirror the zoning by-law that is under appeal. The developer committed to two affordable units and to covering tree-related costs. Staff said no traffic study was required and the parking meets the by-law.

On the Edinburgh Road site, one councillor asked about a land lease instead of a sale. Staff said the funding deadline of the end of 2026 favours a sale. Council then asked for longer affordability and first refusal, and staff said they would work out how the City would price the purchase and how affordability would be monitored.

On the draft strategy, delegates pressed for action on renovation-related evictions and support for nonprofit, co-op and land trust housing. Another delegate said students were barely mentioned. Councillors asked about seniors, larger family units and disaggregated income data, and staff said some of these would be considered for the final report.
